title: Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Shortfall Deadband Card
content:
For Commercial Natural Gas Supply swing shortfall corrections, a shortfall deadband is taken off the measured shortfall therms before they are charged, never below zero. The measured shortfall therms are the therms by which the cycle usage falls short of the lower end the shortfall is measured against. The deadband depends on the energy charge lines on file on the agreement:

| Energy charge lines on file | Shortfall deadband |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 100 therms |
| At least 24 but fewer than 36 | 50 therms |
| Fewer than 24 | No deadband |

## Applying the deadband (hypothetical measured shortfalls)

| Energy charge lines on file | Measured shortfall therms | Therms charged |
|---|---|---|
| 40 | 140 | 40 |
| 40 | 80 | 0, never below zero |
| 30 | 80 | 30 |
| 35 | 50 | 0 |
| 24 | 120 | 70 |
| 18 | 120 | 120 |
